text:
sarah: Heads-up — Acme POC blocked. Their network team reports intermittent TLS handshake failures to our Private Endpoint; app falls back to 502s and resets. They also sent an infosec questionnaire about KMS and logs, plus commercial wants Dedicated POC pricing. Need triage and owners.

raj: Can you drop the client-side error and the server trace? Which hostname are they resolving?

sarah: Client output:```
curl: (35) error:14077410:SSL routines:SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:sslv3 alert handshake failure
POST /v1/chat/completions 502
remote_addr=10.0.2.14
server: redwood-edge-3
```
They resolve to vpce-1234abcd.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com but the app uses host header redwood.acme.internal.

nic: Likely SNI mismatch. Interface endpoint cert CN = vpce hostname; if client sends SNI for redwood.acme.internal handshake fails. Can we capture presented cert?

sarah: TLS capture shows cert subject CN=vpce-1234abcd.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com, SAN only has the vpce name. Customer expected their custom name.

olivia: Also, our edge shows a spike of 429s from their account during the POC run — their harness hammered at ~200 rps and hit rate limits. Sample header:```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rate-limit: 180/60
retry-after: 25
```
We should offer a temporary quota increase and ask them to throttle.

mike: For pricing: short Dedicated trial — we can do a 30-day prorated reserved node, or hosted with credits. I'll draft numbers but we need the blocker gone first.

raj: Immediate infra actions: 1) Confirm whether they enabled "Enable for Private DNS" on the interface endpoint. Without it their resolver won't rewrite the service name and SNI will mismatch. 2) Short-term workaround: have client use the vpce hostname as Host/SNI or add an override in their client. 3) Long-term: documented pattern — resolver rule + private hosted zone pointing to our service, or provide a DNS alias pattern we support.

nic: We should avoid issuing new cert SANs for every customer. Recommend client-side override for POC. Also check NAT/egress if they route through a proxy that strips SNI.

infra-bot: deploy: branch poc-vpce-triage -> staging at 1712345800 :white_check_mark:

sarah: Infosec questions from Acme: Do you support customer-managed KMS for hosted? What log retention do you guarantee for POC and can we get SOC2 artifacts?

olivia: Short answer: hosted offers CMEK under enterprise plan (we can enable envelope encryption with customer KMS for Private and hosted enterprise). We can export audit logs to their S3/SIEM and provide SOC2 report excerpts under NDA. Retention configurable per contract. I'll prepare formal responses.

mike: I'll own the security questionnaire and pricing doc.

raj: Volunteers for owners? I can take DNS/SNI triage and test client override in staging. Olivia owns logs/infosec responses and the temporary quota. Mike owns pricing & T&Cs. Sarah will coordinate with customer NOC and confirm which option they prefer.

sarah: I'll send two unblock options to Acme: (A) Quick unblock: instruct their client to use vpce-1234abcd... as SNI/Host + temporary quota bump. (B) Proper fix: enable private DNS on the endpoint or add a resolver rule + private hosted zone pointing to our service; follow our doc. Will loop in their network and confirm.

mike: If they want a signed SLA for the POC I can attach a 1-page commitment with quota & support hours.

sarah: Thanks all — will post customer confirmation here once I hear back. :thumbsup:
